_about: F1 onboarding change-set. The single source of truth for what 'Deal Won' should fire. onboarding_spec.md documents each target in prose; apply.py reads THIS file so the two cannot drift. Nothing here has been created: every target is either manual_only (no create API exists) or no_credential (the key does not exist in any .env as of 2026-09-22).

extends.name: Deal Won -> ClickUp project + client tag
extends.note: Published today. The extension is built as a SECOND workflow in Draft ('Client Onboarding: kickoff kit') triggered by the same stage move, so the published workflow keeps working untouched while the new one is tested. Merging them is a later, deliberate step.

capability_reasons.manual_only: GHL has no public create API for workflows, forms or calendars (the API lists workflows and adds contacts to them). A person builds it in the UI from the spec.
capability_reasons.no_credential: No API key for this system exists in Agentic Worklfows/.env or AdveroSolutions/.env as of 2026-09-22, so there is nothing to diff against and nothing to apply.

targets.name: {client_slug}
targets.blocker: The service account (credentials.json) has zero Drive storage quota, so it cannot create files or folders anywhere it is not already a member. Either Lorenzo creates the tree by hand from the template, or he shares a parent folder that a real user account owns and the job uses OAuth as that user.

separate_from.name: Discovery Call
separate_from.why: Discovery is 15 minutes, 6 a day, and sells. Kickoff is 45 minutes, 2 a day, and delivers. Sharing one calendar lets a kickoff eat a sales slot.

targets.name: First installment, {client_name}
targets.rule: One invoice per product, raised at Won, due on the kickoff date. Performance deals (reactivation) raise NO invoice at Won: they invoice monthly against the F3 scorecard, and the change-set must skip them rather than send a zero-dollar invoice.
targets.blocker: No STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in any .env. Until there is one, the workflow step is an internal task for Lorenzo that carries the amount and the due date.
No ClickUp API token in any .env. The ClickUp MCP is available inside a Claude session but writing through it is a live write, so it stays off tonight.

products.name: Content and lead system (30 day)
products.kit: none yet (Mike at Man Transformed is the only one; productize it after the day-21 results snapshot)
